A doorway opening softly where the walls once held tight.
One word can cross the distance neither map nor compass
Measures, finding hidden gardens underneath the silence growing between us.
It asks for nothing grander than a moment freely given,
A glance, a breath, a welcome beneath an ordinary heaven.
